entry.name: printerUrl
entry.label: Base URL of the printer's PrusaLink web service, e.g. http://192.168.1.60

entry.name: username
entry.label: PrusaLink username for HTTP Digest login.

entry.name: password
entry.label: PrusaLink password for HTTP Digest login.

entry.name: apiKey
entry.label: PrusaLink API key, sent as X-Api-Key. When set, it is used instead of the username and password.

entry.name: webUiUrl
entry.label: Web UI URL to open on click. Leave blank to use the printer URL.

entry.name: pollIntervalActive
entry.label: Poll interval in seconds while a print is active.

entry.name: pollIntervalIdle
entry.label: Poll interval in seconds while idle.

entry.name: showThumbnail
entry.label: Show the current print's thumbnail on the panel when available.
